exercises: allOf with exactly one member, the idiom for attaching a description to a $ref under OAS 3.0
note: This shape exists because OAS 3.0 forbids siblings of $ref. Wrapping the reference in a single-member allOf is the only way to attach a description to it, so it is common and must not render as a composite.
doNotChangeFixture: Assertions marked pending describe correct behaviour the browser does not have yet. A failure on one of them is a backlog item, not a fixture defect. Do not edit this fixture or its expectations to match what the app currently does.

expected.assert: BookSummary renders as Book: the single member is unwrapped, and the label is not the literal word allOf.
Book's two properties render under BookSummary.
BookSummary's own description, 'The same record, described for the summary view.', is shown in preference to the member's.
expected.why: Unwrapping replaces the node with its single member outright, so the wrapper's description is discarded along with the wrapper.
